reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: Code reading verified (line 328 in peerdas_helpers.nim accesses cell_proofs[i * CELLS_PER_EXT_BLOB + j] without bounds check). However, 01e property (file: 01e_PARTIAL_W3B4_1771748827.json, line 699-715) explicitly classifies this as attacker_controlled=false, bug_bounty_scope=conditional, exploitability=conditional. All call sites (nimbus_beacon_node.nim:2054, rest_beacon_api.nim:1108, beacon_validators.nim:587) receive cell_proofs from Engine API (semi-trusted EL). Per BUG_BOUNTY_SCOPE.json trust_assumptions.engine_api, the Engine API is authenticated via JWT and considered semi-trusted. This is a code-intrinsic issue in how the CL assembles sidecars from EL-provided data, not an attacker-triggered vulnerability. Exploitation requires a compromised or buggy local EL to send malformed BlobsBundle with insufficient proofs, which is a prerequisite attack (semi-trusted boundary). Per Step C2 classification: semi-trusted boundary issue → DOWNGRADED. Severity reduced from Medium to Low per semi-trusted classification (requires local component compromise).
reviewed_items.spec_reference: 01e PROP-57888860-pre-006: Proof slicing indices in cells_and_kzg_proofs_construction must always be within blobs_bundle.proofs bounds. Spec classifies as Engine API (semi-trusted) entry point.
